fields.label: Location
fields.note: Rendered board shows a Location filter and POST job/newfilters returns its vocabulary as location[].{_id,name} (currently only Remote). The observed listing body carries no location key; the applied-filter payload is built in a lazy chunk, so server-side narrowing is unproven.

fields.label: Department
fields.note: Filter is enabled (getCompanyConfig careers_filters.department="1") and job/newfilters returns a department bucket, currently empty. No department key appears in the listing body, so filtering is local.

fields.label: Employee Type
fields.note: Filter is enabled (careers_filters.employee_type="1"); job/newfilters returns employee_type, currently empty.

fields.label: Job Tag
fields.note: Portal labels this control Job Tag (careers_filters.job_tags="1"); job/newfilters returns a job_tags bucket, currently empty. Mapped to job_family because the schema has no job_tag key.

fields.label: Country
fields.note: Filter is enabled (careers_filters.country="1"); job/newfilters returns a country bucket, currently empty.

notes: BharatPe's official /career/ page (client-rendered) links to its Darwinbox candidate board. Listing is POST https://bharatpe.darwinbox.in/ms/candidateapi/job/alljobs?companyId=main with {companyId:"main",page,sort_option,limit}; the bundle's loadAllJobs(payload) posts that payload verbatim, so no filter or keyword keys are added by the listing call as observed. Facet vocabulary comes from POST job/newfilters?companyId=main {companyId:"main",id:[]}, which returns employee_type, functional_area, location, department, job_tags, country, capability. getCompanyConfig careers_filters enables department, location, experience, employee_type, job_tags, country, job_title (functional_area and capability are "0"); the rendered board shows Department, Location, Employee Type, Job Tag, Country, Experience. The Experience control has no facet bucket (it is a range control) and is therefore not modelled as a field. A keyword box is rendered ('Search by role, department or location'), but no keyword key appears in the listing body; the bundle declares unused constants jobSearch:"job?" and search:"search" and the applied-filter/search dispatch sits in a lazy chunk, so keyword_param is null and matching is local. Pagination is page/limit in the same POST body (UI starts page 1, limit 10, sort_option new). The board currently lists 0 jobs (job_counts 0, live 2026-11-07), which makes any server-side narrowing unobservable, hence native_query false.
evidence: https://bharatpe.darwinbox.in/ms/candidatev2/main.819c4120b20f8091.js (loadAllJobs posts payload verbatim; sort_option:"relevance" dispatch; endpoint constants allJobs/newFilters/jobSearch)
https://bharatpe.darwinbox.in/ms/candidatev2/main/careers/allJobs (rendered: 'Search by role, department or location', filters Department/Location/Employee Type/Job Tag/Country/Experience)
